gpu.actualInput: Existing genuine LINZ RGBA/heights fixture; four distinct diagnostic image tags and height offsets. Warm draw and mip pipelines before each measured sample; evict warm tiles and perform four new uploads. Three alternating trials per mode, sequential backend runs.

modes.1: four standalone mip submissions, then frame
modes.2: one mip batch submission, then frame
modes.3: mip batch and frame in one submission

gpu.selectedPolicy: Merged mip/frame submission on Vulkan only; keep GLES default because software timing results varied/regressed between measurement rounds. CPU mip fallback stays unchanged.
